business_summary: Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of compound seasonings in China. It operates through Parent Company, Tianwei Home, Tianwei Heyuan, Zigong Tianwei, Ruisheng Investment, Group Home, and Hainan Bohuai segments. The company offers ready-to-cook seasonings, hot pot seasonings, sauces, and other seasonings; and fish seasoning, handmade hot pot, beef tallow hot pot base, Chinese dish seasoning, crayfish seasoning, catering seasoning, winter seasoning, chicken powder, and non-spicy soup series products. It also provides hot pot base series products; soy, sweet bean, and spicy sauces; and customized seasoning solutions, such as fast food and Chinese food series, and specialty dishes. In addition, the company offers recipe-based seasonings, sausage and cured meat seasonings, and condiments. Further, it engages in investment and marketing planning activities. The company sells its products through offline and online channels under the Hao Ren Jia, Da Hong Pao, Tian Che, Teway Food, Shi Cui Fang, Taste Matters, Tianwei Food Professional Seasoning Customization, Jia Dian Zi Wei, and Yi Pin Wei Xiang brands. It also exports its products to approximately 50 countries and regions. Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
business_summary_ko: Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 복합 조미료의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 모회사, Tianwei Home, Tianwei Heyuan, Zigong Tianwei, Ruisheng Investment, Group Home 및 Hainan Bohuai 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 바로 조리 가능한 조미료, 전골 조미료, 소스 및 기타 조미료를 제공합니다. 생선조미료, 수제전골, 우지전골베이스, 중식조미료, 가재조미, 케이터링조미료, 겨울양념, 치킨가루, 무매운탕 시리즈 제품을 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 냄비 기본 시리즈 제품을 제공합니다. 간장, 팥, 매운 소스; 패스트푸드, 중식 시리즈, 특선 요리 등 맞춤형 조미료 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 밖에도 레시피 기반의 조미료, 소시지 및 염지 조미료, 조미료 등도 판매하고 있다. 또한 투자 및 마케팅 기획 활동에도 참여합니다. 회사는 Hao Ren Jia, Da Hong Pao, Tian Che, Teway Food, Shi Cui Fang, Taste Matters, Tianwei Food Professional Seasoning Customization, Jia Dian Zi Wei 및 Yi Pin Wei Xiang bra로 오프라인 및 온라인 채널을 통해 제품을 판매합니다.
